question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

He was __too tired for walking__ anymore.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'too tired to walk'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part in the given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'too tired to walk' **should be used instead of** 'too tired for walking'.**
 
• The **conjunction** '**too**' is followed by '**to**'. We cannot use any other **preposition** here.
 
• '**walking**' will be changed into '**walk**' because after the '**to**' **infinitive** we should use the **base form **of the **verb**.
 
• It means 'more than is necessary or desirable'. 
 
 
• *Example: He was **too nervous to** perform well on the stage.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 2.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *He was **too** tired **to** walk anymore.*
